name: io.github.udondan/anton
title: anton.app
description: Unofficial anton.app parent tools: children's learning progress, lessons and assignments

environmentVariables.name: ANTON_LOGIN_CODE
environmentVariables.description: 8-character parent login code from the anton app. Needed unless ANTON_LOG_ID or ~/.config/anton/config provides credentials.

environmentVariables.name: ANTON_LOG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Parent log ID (L-...), an alternative to ANTON_LOGIN_CODE

environmentVariables.name: ANTON_GROUP
environmentVariables.description: Default group name when the parent belongs to several groups (case-insensitive)

environmentVariables.name: ANTON_ASSIGNMENTS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of the local assignments file (default: ~/.config/anton/assignments.json)
